theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 5 群

items.colloc: book business class 預訂商務艙 | upgrade to business class 升等至商務艙
items.distinct: economy class 經濟艙 | first class 頭等艙
ex: The executive prefers flying business class for long trips.
主管偏好在長途旅行時搭乘商務艙。
Our company policy covers business class for international flights.
公司政策支付國際航班的商務艙費用。
Business class seats offer extra legroom and better service.
商務艙座位提供額外的腿部空間與更好的服務。

items.pos: phr. 營業時間；辦公時間
items.colloc: during business hours 在營業時間內 | outside business hours 非辦公時間
items.distinct: office hours 辦公時間 | opening hours 開放時間
ex: Please call our office during regular business hours.
請在正常的辦公時間內致電我們辦公室。
We respond to all customer emails within business hours.
我們會在營業時間內回覆所有客戶的電子郵件。
The delivery will arrive during standard business hours.
快遞將會在標準營業時間內抵達。

items.colloc: book a conference room 預訂會議室 | reserve the conference room 保留會議室
items.distinct: meeting room 會議室（小型） | boardroom 董事會議室
ex: The marketing team is meeting in the main conference room.
行銷團隊正在主要會議室開會。
Please reserve the conference room for our afternoon presentation.
請為我們下午的簡報預訂會議室。
Is the large conference room available for the training session?
大型會議室有空檔供培訓課程使用嗎？

items.pos: phr. 與…衝突；與…時間重疊
items.colloc: scheduling conflict 時間衝突 | avoid conflict 避免衝突
items.distinct: disagree with 不同意 | clash with 衝突（更強烈）
ex: This appointment might conflict with your existing schedule.
這個預約可能會與您現有的行程衝突。
The new project timeline does not conflict with the deadline.
新的專案時程表與截止日期並不衝突。
My client meeting will conflict with the team building event.
我的客戶會議將與團隊建設活動時間重疊。

items.colloc: wash and dry dishes 洗滌並擦乾碗盤 | help dry dishes 幫忙擦碗盤
items.distinct: do the dishes 洗碗 | drain dishes 瀝乾碗盤
ex: We need to wash and dry dishes after the company lunch.
公司午餐後我們需要清洗並擦乾碗盤。
Could you please help dry dishes in the pantry?
你可以幫忙在茶水間擦乾碗盤嗎？
The staff will dry dishes before storing them in cabinets.
員工會在將碗盤收進櫥櫃前將其擦乾。

items.colloc: hired a fashion photographer 聘請時尚攝影師 | famous fashion photographer 知名時尚攝影師
items.distinct: press photographer 新聞攝影師 | portrait photographer 人像攝影師
ex: The magazine hired a famous fashion photographer for the shoot.
雜誌社聘請了一位知名時尚攝影師進行拍攝。
Working as a fashion photographer requires a creative eye.
擔任時尚攝影師需要具備創造性的眼光。
Our company interviewed a fashion photographer for the campaign.
我們公司為這項宣傳活動面試了一位時尚攝影師。

items.colloc: attend a film festival 參加電影節 | host a film festival 主辦電影節
items.distinct: movie premiere 電影首映 | awards ceremony 頒獎典禮
ex: Our department will sponsor the upcoming annual film festival.
我們部門將贊助即將到來的年度電影節。
Many international directors will attend this year's film festival.
許多國際導演將參加今年的電影節。
The film festival attracts thousands of cinema enthusiasts annually.
電影節每年吸引數千名電影愛好者。

items.colloc: get it for free 免費取得 | offer for free 免費提供
items.distinct: at no cost 免費（正式） | complimentary 免費贈送（禮貌）
ex: New customers can download the software trial for free.
新客戶可以免費下載軟體試用版。
The company provided extra training sessions for free.
公司免費提供了額外的培訓課程。
We are offering a consultation session for free this month.
我們本月提供免費的諮詢服務。

items.colloc: give me a call 給我打電話 | give a call later 之後再打
items.distinct: make a call 撥打電話 | return a call 回電
ex: Please give a call if you have any further questions.
如果您有任何進一步的問題，請打電話給我們。
I will give a call to the supplier to confirm delivery.
我會打電話給供應商確認送貨事宜。
Feel free to give a call before visiting our office.
前來我們辦公室之前，歡迎隨時打電話。

items.colloc: hand out flyers 分發傳單 | hand out documents 分發文件
items.distinct: distribute 分配（正式） | pass out 昏倒或發放
ex: The assistant will hand out the agendas before the meeting.
助理將在會議前分發議程表。
Please hand out these brochures to all the participants.
請將這些手冊分發給所有參與者。
It is standard procedure to hand out name tags at registration.
在報到處分發名牌是標準程序。

items.colloc: move in the direction of 朝…方向移動 | look in the direction of 看向…的方向
items.distinct: towards 朝向 | in the way of 以…方式
ex: The warehouse is located in the direction of the airport.
倉庫位於朝向機場的方向。
Please walk in the direction of the main lobby entrance.
請往主大廳入口的方向走。
He pointed in the direction of the new office building.
他指向新辦公大樓的方向。

items.colloc: in the past few years 在過去幾年 | look into the past 回顧過去
items.distinct: in the future 在未來 | at present 目前
ex: In the past, our company relied solely on print ads.
在過去，我們公司完全依賴平面廣告。
The procedures were quite complicated in the past.
這些程序在過去相當複雜。
We have faced similar challenges in the past successfully.
我們在過去曾成功面對過類似的挑戰。

items.colloc: nice looking design 美觀的設計 | nice looking office 看起來不錯的辦公室
items.distinct: attractive 有吸引力的 | professional 專業的
ex: This is a very nice looking layout for our presentation.
這份簡報的排版看起來非常美觀。
The new product packaging is quite nice looking.
新產品的包裝看起來很不錯。
She selected a nice looking desk for the reception area.
她為接待區選了一張好看的辦公桌。

items.colloc: travel on foot 步行旅遊 | reach by foot 步行抵達
items.distinct: by car 開車 | by public transport 搭乘大眾運輸
ex: The office is close enough to reach on foot.
辦公室距離很近，可以步行抵達。
Many employees prefer to explore the city on foot.
許多員工偏好步行探索這座城市。
We decided to travel on foot to the nearby restaurant.
我們決定步行去附近的餐廳。

items.colloc: go to pick up packages 去領取包裹 | pick up packages at the desk 在櫃台領取包裹
items.distinct: deliver packages 運送包裹 | receive packages 收到包裹
ex: I need to go to the post office to pick up packages.
我需要去郵局領取包裹。
Please pick up packages from the mail room this afternoon.
請今天下午到郵件室領取包裹。
The courier left a notice to pick up packages today.
快遞員留下通知要求今天領取包裹。

items.colloc: fill out a request form 填寫申請表 | submit a request form 提交申請表
items.distinct: application form 報名表；申請書 | feedback form 回饋表
ex: You must submit a request form for extra office supplies.
你必須為額外的辦公用品提交申請表。
Please complete the request form to change your password.
請填寫此申請表以變更您的密碼。
The HR department requires a signed request form.
人資部門需要一份簽署過的申請表格。

items.colloc: shake hands with someone 與某人握手 | a firm shake hands 堅定的握手
items.distinct: bow 鞠躬 | wave 手勢揮動
ex: It is common to shake hands during business introductions.
在商務介紹過程中握手是很常見的。
The two CEOs decided to shake hands after the deal.
兩位執行長決定在交易達成後握手。
Always make eye contact when you shake hands.
握手時請務必保持眼神接觸。

items.colloc: attend the store opening 參加商店開幕 | store opening ceremony 商店開幕典禮
items.distinct: grand opening 盛大開幕 | store closing 商店歇業
ex: We are preparing for the grand store opening next month.
我們正在為下個月的盛大商店開幕做準備。
The store opening attracted many local shoppers.
商店開幕吸引了許多當地顧客。
Management invited key investors to the store opening.
管理階層邀請重要投資人參加商店開幕。

items.colloc: plan to take a vacation 計畫去度假 | take a vacation leave 請假去度假
items.distinct: go on holiday 去度假（英式） | take time off 請假
ex: The manager decided to take a vacation in July.
經理決定在七月去度假。
Employees are encouraged to take a vacation to recharge.
我們鼓勵員工度假以恢復元氣。
I will take a vacation after completing this project.
完成這個專案後我會去度假。

items.colloc: wear a tool belt 穿戴工具腰帶 | heavy tool belt 厚重的工具腰帶
items.distinct: tool box 工具箱 | tool kit 工具組
ex: The technician wears a tool belt for easy access.
技術人員佩戴工具腰帶以便拿取工具。
Maintenance workers must keep their tool belt organized.
維修人員必須保持工具腰帶整理有序。
A sturdy tool belt is essential for the construction crew.
堅固的工具腰帶對建築團隊來說至關重要。
